name: Secrets of the Colossus - Regal
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
There ain't nothin' I'd like more than to stuff this bug husk down Oilfist's fat face... Cept, I'm stuck here collectin' samples from that overgrown cockroach. I'll be here 'till the wee mornin' hours given the size o' that thing.

Take this here sample to Oilfist fer me and do it fast, champion. He's payin' BIG!

Yar, Thorium Point - it be in the Searin' Gorge.
narrative.objectives: Take the Colossus of Regal's Husk to Overseer Oilfist in Searing Gorge.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent. We could surely devise some incredibly powerful armor from this chitin. Here's the riches you were promised.
